title: roko.price_snapshot/1
description: A dated price snapshot, config/prices/<date>.toml, as parsed by tomllib (S08 §5.6). Snapshots are immutable: new prices mean a new file with a new id. validate.py also checks that slugs are unique, every rate is above 0 and each row's columns are in the order listed here.

fetched_at.description: the date the rates were read, YYYY-MM-DD (a quoted string, not a TOML date)

slug.description: the model name the provider reports; costs are priced by model_reported

cache_read.description: equals input when the provider publishes no read discount

cache_write_5m.description: equals input when the provider publishes no write premium

cache_write_1h.description: equals input when the provider publishes no write premium

reasoning_in_output.description: true: reasoning tokens are already inside output tokens and are not added again

verified.description: how and when the rates were checked
